WITH next_job AS (
    SELECT j.id

    FROM automation_jobs j

    JOIN campaigns c
        ON c.id = j.campaign_id

    JOIN approvals a
        ON a.id = j.approval_id

    WHERE j.job_type = 'generate_revision'

      AND j.status = 'queued'

      AND j.available_at <= NOW()

      AND j.attempts < j.max_attempts

      AND c.status = 'revision_requested'

      AND a.decision = 'revision_requested'

    ORDER BY
        j.available_at ASC,
        j.created_at ASC

    FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED

    LIMIT 1
),

claimed_job AS (
    UPDATE automation_jobs j

    SET
        status = 'processing',
        attempts = j.attempts + 1,
        locked_at = NOW(),
        completed_at = NULL,
        last_error = NULL

    FROM next_job n

    WHERE j.id = n.id

    RETURNING
        j.id,
        j.job_type,
        j.campaign_id,
        j.campaign_version_id,
        j.approval_id,
        j.status,
        j.payload,
        j.attempts,
        j.max_attempts,
        j.available_at,
        j.locked_at,
        j.created_at
)

SELECT
    claimed_job.id::TEXT
        AS job_id,

    claimed_job.job_type,
    claimed_job.status
        AS job_status,

    claimed_job.attempts,
    claimed_job.max_attempts,
    claimed_job.available_at,
    claimed_job.locked_at,

    c.id::TEXT
        AS campaign_id,

    c.campaign_code,
    c.product_service,
    c.target_audience,
    c.offer,
    c.objective,
    c.brand_tone,
    c.brief,
    c.status
        AS campaign_status,

    cv.id::TEXT
        AS previous_version_id,

    cv.version_number
        AS previous_version_number,

    cv.content
        AS previous_content,

    cv.model_name
        AS previous_model_name,

    cv.prompt_version
        AS previous_prompt_version,

    (
        SELECT
            COALESCE(
                MAX(existing_version.version_number),
                0
            ) + 1

        FROM campaign_versions existing_version

        WHERE existing_version.campaign_id =
            claimed_job.campaign_id
    ) AS next_version_number,

    a.id::TEXT
        AS source_approval_id,

    a.reviewer_name,
    a.reviewer_email,

    a.feedback
        AS reviewer_feedback,

    cl.id::TEXT
        AS client_id,

    cl.client_code,
    cl.name
        AS client_name,

    cl.company_name,
    cl.email
        AS client_email,

    cl.website

FROM claimed_job

JOIN campaigns c
    ON c.id = claimed_job.campaign_id

JOIN campaign_versions cv
    ON cv.id =
       claimed_job.campaign_version_id

JOIN approvals a
    ON a.id =
       claimed_job.approval_id

JOIN clients cl
    ON cl.id = c.client_id;

WITH input_data AS (
    SELECT $1::JSONB AS data
),

save_version AS (
    INSERT INTO campaign_versions (
        campaign_id,
        version_number,
        generation_type,
        model_name,
        prompt_version,
        content,
        validation_status,
        validation_errors
    )

    SELECT
        (data->>'campaign_id')::UUID,

        (data->>'version_number')::INTEGER,

        'revision',

        data->>'model_name',

        data->>'prompt_version',

        data->'content',

        'passed',

        '[]'::JSONB

    FROM input_data

    ON CONFLICT (
        campaign_id,
        version_number
    )

    DO UPDATE SET
        generation_type =
            EXCLUDED.generation_type,

        model_name =
            EXCLUDED.model_name,

        prompt_version =
            EXCLUDED.prompt_version,

        content =
            EXCLUDED.content,

        validation_status =
            'passed',

        validation_errors =
            '[]'::JSONB

    RETURNING
        id,
        campaign_id,
        version_number,
        generation_type,
        model_name,
        prompt_version,
        validation_status,
        created_at
),

update_campaign AS (
    UPDATE campaigns c

    SET status = 'awaiting_approval'

    FROM save_version

    WHERE c.id =
        save_version.campaign_id

    RETURNING
        c.id,
        c.campaign_code,
        c.status,
        c.updated_at
),

write_log AS (
    INSERT INTO automation_logs (
        workflow_name,
        campaign_id,
        level,
        event_type,
        message,
        details
    )

    SELECT
        '07 - Revision Job Worker',

        save_version.campaign_id,

        'info',

        'ai_campaign_revision_created',

        'A revised AI campaign package was generated and validated successfully.',

        jsonb_build_object(
            'campaign_code',
                update_campaign.campaign_code,

            'job_id',
                input_data.data->>'job_id',

            'source_campaign_version_id',
                input_data.data
                    ->>'source_campaign_version_id',

            'source_approval_id',
                input_data.data
                    ->>'source_approval_id',

            'new_campaign_version_id',
                save_version.id,

            'version_number',
                save_version.version_number,

            'model_name',
                save_version.model_name,

            'prompt_version',
                save_version.prompt_version,

            'interaction_id',
                input_data.data->>'interaction_id',

            'reviewer_name',
                input_data.data->>'reviewer_name',

            'reviewer_email',
                input_data.data->>'reviewer_email',

            'reviewer_feedback',
                input_data.data
                    ->>'reviewer_feedback',

            'usage',
                COALESCE(
                    input_data.data->'usage',
                    '{}'::JSONB
                )
        )

    FROM save_version

    JOIN update_campaign
        ON update_campaign.id =
           save_version.campaign_id

    CROSS JOIN input_data

    RETURNING id
)

SELECT
    input_data.data->>'job_id'
        AS job_id,

    save_version.id::TEXT
        AS campaign_version_id,

    save_version.campaign_id::TEXT
        AS campaign_id,

    update_campaign.campaign_code,

    save_version.version_number,

    save_version.generation_type,

    save_version.model_name,

    save_version.prompt_version,

    save_version.validation_status,

    update_campaign.status
        AS campaign_status,

    save_version.created_at,

    update_campaign.updated_at

FROM save_version

JOIN update_campaign
    ON update_campaign.id =
       save_version.campaign_id

CROSS JOIN input_data;

WITH input_data AS (
    SELECT $1::JSONB AS data
),

complete_job AS (
    UPDATE automation_jobs j

    SET
        status = 'completed',
        completed_at = NOW(),
        locked_at = NULL,
        last_error = NULL

    FROM input_data i

    WHERE j.id =
        (i.data->>'job_id')::UUID

      AND j.job_type =
          'generate_revision'

      AND j.status =
          'processing'

    RETURNING
        j.id,
        j.job_type,
        j.campaign_id,
        j.campaign_version_id,
        j.approval_id,
        j.status,
        j.attempts,
        j.max_attempts,
        j.created_at,
        j.completed_at,
        j.updated_at
),

write_log AS (
    INSERT INTO automation_logs (
        workflow_name,
        campaign_id,
        level,
        event_type,
        message,
        details
    )

    SELECT
        '07 - Revision Job Worker',

        complete_job.campaign_id,

        'info',

        'revision_job_completed',

        'The revision job completed and a new approval request was created.',

        jsonb_build_object(
            'job_id',
                complete_job.id,

            'campaign_code',
                input_data.data->>'campaign_code',

            'campaign_version_id',
                input_data.data
                    ->>'campaign_version_id',

            'approval_id',
                input_data.data->>'approval_id',

            'review_url',
                input_data.data->>'review_url',

            'attempts',
                complete_job.attempts
        )

    FROM complete_job

    CROSS JOIN input_data

    RETURNING id
)

SELECT
    complete_job.id::TEXT
        AS job_id,

    complete_job.job_type,

    complete_job.campaign_id::TEXT
        AS campaign_id,

    complete_job.status
        AS job_status,

    complete_job.attempts,

    complete_job.max_attempts,

    complete_job.completed_at,

    input_data.data->>'campaign_code'
        AS campaign_code,

    input_data.data->>'campaign_version_id'
        AS campaign_version_id,

    input_data.data->>'approval_id'
        AS approval_id,

    input_data.data->>'review_url'
        AS review_url

FROM complete_job

CROSS JOIN input_data;
